```{r, echo=FALSE}
ice_df_table <- ice_df

# Change n/a values to "-"
ice_df_table$Age[is.na(ice_df_table$Age)] <- "-"
ice_df_table$State[is.na(ice_df_table$State)] <- "-"
ice_df_table$City[is.na(ice_df_table$City)] <- "-"
ice_df_table$County[is.na(ice_df_table$County)] <- "-"
ice_df_table$`Cause of Death (Official)`[is.na(ice_df_table$`Cause of Death (Official)`)] <- "-"
ice_df_table$`Cause of Death (Unofficial)`[is.na(ice_df_table$`Cause of Death (Unofficial)`)] <- "-"
ice_df_table$`Facilities & Transfers`[is.na(ice_df_table$`Facilities & Transfers`)] <- "-"
ice_df_table$`Other Notes`[is.na(ice_df_table$`Other Notes`)] <- "-"

# Drop Drive Link to Sources Column
ice_df_table <- ice_df_table %>% select(-`Drive Link to Sources`)

```


```{r}
#| echo: false

reactable(
  ice_df_table,

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # GENERAL TABLE SETTINGS
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  class = "my-table",

  fullWidth = TRUE,

  bordered = FALSE,

  striped = TRUE,

  highlight = TRUE,

  compact = FALSE,

  resizable = TRUE,

  defaultPageSize = 15,

  paginationType = "jump",


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # DEFAULT COLUMN SETTINGS
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  defaultColDef = colDef(
    align = "left",

    headerStyle = list(
      fontWeight = "700"
    ),

    style = list(
      whiteSpace = "nowrap",
      overflow = "hidden",
      textOverflow = "ellipsis"
    )
  ),


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # LONG-TEXT COLUMNS
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  columns = list(

    `Name` = colDef(
      minWidth = 220,
      width = 250,

      cell = function(value) {

        div(
          title = value,

          style = list(
            whiteSpace = "nowrap",
            overflow = "hidden",
            textOverflow = "ellipsis"
          ),

          value
        )
      }
    ),


    `Location` = colDef(
      minWidth = 180,

          ),

          value
        )
      }
    ),


    `Cause of Death (Official)` = colDef(

        div(
          title = value,

          style = list(
            whiteSpace = "nowrap",
            overflow = "hidden",
            textOverflow = "ellipsis"
          ),

          value
        )
      }
    ),


    `Cause of Death (Unofficial)` = colDef(

        )

    `Facilities & Transfers` = colDef(

        )
```
